questions.prompt: Why is storing per-user session state in a module-level `export const userStore = writable(null)` dangerous in a SvelteKit SSR app?

options.text: Module-level variables on a Node/edge server persist across requests and can leak one user's data to another user

questions.prompt: Why does Svelte recommend `$derived` over `$effect` whenever a value can be computed from existing reactive state?

options.text: `$effect` runs asynchronously after render, causing extra work, potential flicker, and harder-to-trace state cycles

questions.prompt: What causes a hydration mismatch when SSR HTML differs from initial client render in SvelteKit?

options.text: Reading `Date.now()`, `Math.random()`, or `localStorage` directly during initial component render instead of `onMount` or server `load`

questions.prompt: Match each SvelteKit rendering option to its trade-off.

columns.label: Fresh server HTML per request, great SEO, needs server runtime
Static HTML generated at build time for CDN speed
Client-only rendering; simpler when relying heavily on browser-only APIs

questions.prompt: How does `$state.raw` improve performance for large immutable datasets (e.g., 20,000 chart points)?

options.text: It skips creating deep recursive `Proxy` wrappers on nested objects/arrays and only tracks reassignment

questions.prompt: Select all practices that prevent memory leaks and stale async updates in Svelte components. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Use `$store` auto-subscription or unsubscribe manual `.subscribe()` calls
Keep global `setInterval` timers running without cleanup on route changes
Abort in-flight `fetch` requests with `AbortController` in `$effect` / `onMount` teardown

questions.prompt: What security boundary do SvelteKit's `$env/static/private` and `+page.server.js` enforce?

options.text: Compile-time guarantee that server secrets and DB credentials cannot be imported into browser bundles

questions.prompt: What does SvelteKit's built-in CSRF origin check protect against on form POST / `+server.js` requests?

options.text: Cross-site form/POST submissions from untrusted third-party origins when using cookie auth

questions.prompt: Why is `{@html sanitized}` still a security-sensitive sink that requires extra care?

options.text: Any gap in HTML sanitization allows XSS script/event-handler execution in the user's browser

questions.prompt: How does Svelte's compiler help catch accessibility regressions early?

options.text: It runs Lighthouse on every keystroke
It emits compile-time `a11y_*` warnings for missing `alt`, invalid ARIA roles, clickable `<div>`s without keyboard handlers, etc.

questions.prompt: Select all practices that keep Svelte component tests fast and resilient. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Trigger realistic interactions (`userEvent.click`, `userEvent.type`) and await DOM updates
Mock network/API boundaries rather than internal reactive implementation details
Assert internal compiled `$$` / private variable names

questions.prompt: Why should an `$effect` avoid both reading AND writing the exact same `$state` variable unconditionally?

options.text: It creates an infinite reactive loop (`effect_update_depth_exceeded`)

questions.prompt: What is the cleanest way to avoid `effect_update_depth_exceeded` if an `$effect` genuinely needs to read a value without subscribing to it?
In SvelteKit, why is `invalidate('app:items')` + `depends('app:items')` useful after a mutation?

options.text: It re-runs only the `load()` functions tagged with `'app:items'` instead of reloading all layout/page data

questions.prompt: Match each Svelte performance or architecture issue to its fix.
What does `adapter-auto`, `adapter-vercel`, `adapter-node`, or `adapter-static` configure in `svelte.config.js`?

options.text: How SvelteKit builds and packages routes/functions for a specific hosting target

questions.prompt: Why can `adapter-static` NOT run `+page.server.js` `actions` at runtime?

options.text: Static hosting serves pre-built HTML/JS/CSS files with no runtime Node/serverless backend to handle POST actions

questions.prompt: What does `fail(400, { email, missing: true })` returned from a SvelteKit form action do?

options.text: Returns HTTP 400 with structured validation errors to `form` prop without throwing a 500 error page

questions.prompt: Select all valid ways to optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) in a Svelte / SvelteKit app. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Block initial render with synchronous 5MB JSON parsing in `<script>`
Prerender or SSR critical above-the-fold HTML so content paints before JS finishes
Use explicit `width` and `height` (or aspect-ratio) on images and media to prevent CLS
Code-split heavy client libraries (charts/editors) via dynamic `import()`

questions.prompt: When integrating a third-party imperative library (like Mapbox or Chart.js) in Svelte, where should initialization and `.destroy()` live?

options.text: Inside `$effect` (or `onMount`) bound to a `bind:this` DOM node, returning a cleanup that calls `.destroy()`

questions.prompt: What does `export const prerender = true;` inside a `+page.js` or `+layout.js` do?

options.text: Generates static HTML for that route at build time instead of rendering per request
Runs the route in a Web Worker

questions.prompt: Match each SvelteKit error/redirect helper to its HTTP behavior.

columns.label: Redirects browser to `/login` (303 See Other after POST)
Returns 422 validation payload to the current page's `form` prop

questions.prompt: Why should you pass `fetch` provided by SvelteKit's `load({ fetch })` rather than global `window.fetch` inside `load` functions?

options.text: SvelteKit's `load` `fetch` handles relative URLs during SSR, forwards cookies/headers on internal requests, and avoids duplicate client fetches during hydration

questions.prompt: What happens during hydration if a client component reads `localStorage.getItem('theme')` synchronously in `<script>` to change rendered text?

options.text: Server renders default text while client initially renders stored text, causing a hydration mismatch or flash

questions.prompt: Select all statements that are true about Svelte's `use:action` cleanup and `update` lifecycle. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Actions only run in the browser (not during SSR)
Actions run on the server during SSR to mutate `document`
`destroy()` runs when the element is removed from the DOM
`update(newParams)` runs when reactive parameters passed to `use:action={params}` change

questions.prompt: Why is `bind:value` on a 50-field form sometimes paired with explicit validation schemas (e.g., Zod / Superforms) in production?

options.text: Schemas validate both client UX and server POST payloads from one shared definition

questions.prompt: What does `svelte:options runes={true}` or `compilerOptions: { runes: true }` in `svelte.config.js` enforce?

options.text: Enforces Svelte 5 runes mode consistently across the project so legacy Svelte 4 `$:` syntax is not mixed unintentionally

questions.prompt: What is a common cause of unnecessary re-renders in a Svelte `{#each}` list?

options.text: Recreating or mutating unrelated wrapper objects/props or omitting `(item.id)` keys on stateful rows

questions.prompt: What does `import { dev } from '$app/environment'` allow in SvelteKit?

options.text: Conditionally enabling debug tooling or verbose logging only in local development

questions.prompt: Why should `hooks.server.js` validate session cookies on every protected request instead of trusting a client-sent `userId` field?

options.text: Cookies cannot be read on the server
Client-sent JSON/headers can be forged by any attacker

questions.prompt: Match each SvelteKit hook or file to its responsibility.

columns.label: Authenticate session per request and populate `event.locals`
Capture unexpected errors and return safe public error IDs
Shared navigation, footer, and page shell across child routes

questions.prompt: What does `await tick()` followed by `element.scrollIntoView()` solve?

options.text: Ensures newly added `{#if}` or `{#each}` DOM nodes exist in the document before scrolling to them

questions.prompt: Select all practices that improve security in SvelteKit apps. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Validate all `request.json()` and `formData()` inputs on the server
Pass `event.locals.user` password hashes into `+page.svelte` `load()` return data

questions.prompt: Why must `load()` in `+page.server.js` return only minimal, safe fields (not full DB user rows with `password_hash`)?

options.text: Everything returned by `load()` is serialized into the HTML/JSON payload sent to the browser

questions.prompt: What does `export const csr = false;` on a purely static SvelteKit page do?

options.text: Ships zero client-side JavaScript for that page (pure server-rendered/prerendered HTML)

options.text: `npm run build` to verify SSR/client bundling and env boundaries

questions.prompt: When using `svelte:head` across nested layouts and pages, what happens if both a layout and a page define `<title>`?

options.text: The child `+page.svelte` `<title>` overrides the parent layout `<title>`

questions.prompt: What does `export const trailingSlash = 'always';` in SvelteKit configure?

options.text: Consistent URL canonicalization with trailing slashes for routing and static builds

questions.prompt: Why is testing SvelteKit forms and navigation with Playwright E2E tests a strong complement to Vitest unit tests?

options.text: Playwright verifies real SSR hydration, cookies, redirects, and progressive enhancement in a real browser

questions.prompt: Match each Svelte 5 feature to what it replaced or improved from Svelte 4.

columns.label: Replaced top-level `let` / `$:` magic with explicit universal runes
Replaced `<slot>` / `let:` with typed reusable template snippets
